component-metadata.description:
Altered sample names are extracted in this metanode. This metanode is necessary for the correct execution of the Normalization tests metanode. In the first step, the user needs to select a set of columns containing a common prefix and suffix whose removal will result in a set of sample names.
The output of this metanode is an unchanged original data table, the set of sample names is included in the output as a flow variable.
